# Experimental Design

Gastric biopsies from patients with intestinal metaplasia were taken from metaplastic and non-metaplastic control sites. Primary gastric epithelial cells were extracted and expanded on feeder cells. Single cell clones were derived, expanded on feeders and then cultured for few passages as organoid cultures to remove feeder cells. 

DNA was isolated and hybridized to the Illumina EPIC methylation array.

To analyse the generated data in R, I will use and further adapt the "Chip Analysis Methylation Pipeline" (ChAMP) package [Morris J, *et al.*, 2013] and use limma for differential methylation analysis

# Data Import

Raw intensity values were preprocessed and QC checked (see "Preprocessing_and_QC.Rmd"). Here I load the sample annotation and the normalized (SWAN) beta values:

```{r Data Import, message=FALSE}

#load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "myLoad_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach_combined.RData"))

load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "myNorm_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach.RData"))


library(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)
full_anno = getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19, "Other")

full_anno = full_anno[, c("UCSC_RefGene_Name", "UCSC_RefGene_Accession", "UCSC_RefGene_Group", "Phantom5_Enhancers", "DMR", "X450k_Enhancer", "Regulatory_Feature_Group", "GencodeCompV12_NAME", "GencodeCompV12_Accession", "GencodeCompV12_Group", "DNase_Hypersensitivity_NAME", "DNase_Hypersensitivity_Evidence_Count", "OpenChromatin_NAME", "OpenChromatin_Evidence_Count", "TFBS_NAME", "TFBS_Evidence_Count")]
```

Here, I now subset the normalized data set, in order to remove all CpGs that between all samples do not change > 20 %.

```{r}

myNorm_sub = myNorm

Diff = rowDiffs(matrixStats::rowRanges(myNorm_sub))

#myNorm_sub = cbind(myNorm_sub, Diff)
#colnames(myNorm_sub)[ncol(myNorm_sub)] = "MaxDiff"  
myNorm_sub = subset(myNorm_sub, Diff > 0.2)

```

# Differential Methylation Analysis

The following comparisons are going to be performed using limma [Ritchie ME, *et al*., 2015] and the subsetted data set:

 <!-- - on per-patient and condition/site average samples, IM vs. Normal (adjusting for stomach site). This is not ideal since there are no Corpus/Fundus IM samples [IMvsNormal] -->

 - on per-patient and condition/site average samples, IM vs. Normal stomach antrum (since almost all IM are antrum in this data set) [IMvsNormalAntrum]

 <!-- - on per-patient and condition/site average samples, non-IM vs. Normal (adjusting for stomach site). This is not ideal since the distribution of sites in Non-IM and normal samples is not necessarily the same [nonIMvsNormal] -->

Finally: 
 
 - on per-patient and condition/site average samples, non-IM vs. Normal (adjusting for stomach site) 

 - 'manual' adjustment for site:

  1. Average samples from same patient and site/group (e.g. IM clones from same patient or Undifferentiated/differentiated Antrum from each patient)
  2. From each IM sample, subtract the average normal sample from the corresponding site (i.e. Antrum-Antrum or Corpus-Corpus). Treat Antrum/Corpus as Corpus. 
  3. Run a one-group test against 0 for the differences. 
  
This is done for IM [IMvsNormal_site.adj] and for non-IM samples [nonIMvsNormal_site.adj]. 


```{r}
wgs_dm_anno <- readRDS("../../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE186458_WGBS_Atlas/Analysis/WGS_DM_Gut_vs_Stomach.rds")
u.m_anno <- readRDS("../../../../Data/Processed/CpG_classifications_u.m_EPIC_and_WGS.rds")
```


```{r Differential Methylation Analysis}

if(rerun_DGE) {
  
  all_results_betas = list()
  
  data_matrix = myNorm_sub

  normal_samples <- subset(ed, Sample_Group == "Normal") |> as.data.frame()
  im_nonim_samples <- subset(ed, Sample_Group != "Normal") |> as.data.frame()
  
  normal_avg <- avearrays(data_matrix[, rownames(normal_samples)], ID = paste0(normal_samples$PatientID, "_Normal_", normal_samples$Stomach_site) )
  im_avg <- avearrays(data_matrix[, rownames(im_nonim_samples)], ID = paste0(gsub("_", ".", im_nonim_samples$PatientID), "_", gsub("_", ".", im_nonim_samples$Sample_Group), "_", im_nonim_samples$Stomach_site))
  
  
  avg_combined <- cbind(normal_avg, im_avg)
  tmp <- strsplit(colnames(avg_combined),"_")
  ed2 <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(avg_combined), 
                   patient = sapply(tmp, `[`, 1), 
                   group = sapply(tmp, `[`, 2),
                   site = sapply(tmp, `[`, 3) )
  ed2$site <- paste0(toupper(substr(ed2$site,1,1)), substr(ed2$site, 2, nchar(ed2$site)) )
  ed2$site_ac <- ifelse(ed2$site == "Junction", "Corpus", ed2$site )
  
  # # IM vs. Normal, adjusting for site
  # sel_conditions = c("IM","Normal")
  # sel_samples = rownames(subset(ed2, group %in% sel_conditions) )
  # edata = avg_combined[,sel_samples]
  # groups = factor(ed2[sel_samples,]$group)
  # site = factor(ed2[sel_samples,]$site_ac)
  # 
  # design = model.matrix(~ site + groups ,  contrasts.arg=list(groups=contr.SAS))
  # 
  # fit <- lmFit(edata,design)
  # fit <- eBayes(fit)
  # all_results_betas[["IMvsNormal"]] = topTable(fit, coef="groups1", adjust="BH", number=nrow(edata))
  # 

  # IM vs. Normal, Antrum only
  sel_conditions = c("IM","Normal")
  sel_samples = rownames(subset(ed2, group %in% sel_conditions &  site == "Antrum") )
  edata = avg_combined[,sel_samples]
  groups = factor(ed2[sel_samples,]$group)
  
  design = model.matrix(~ groups ,  contrasts.arg=list(groups=contr.SAS))
  
  fit <- lmFit(edata,design)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)
  all_results_betas[["IMvsNormalAntrum"]] = topTable(fit, coef="groups1", adjust="BH", number=nrow(edata))

  # 
  # # non-IM vs. Normal, adjusting for site
  # sel_conditions = c("non-IM","Normal")
  # sel_samples = rownames(subset(ed2, group %in% sel_conditions) )
  # edata = avg_combined[,sel_samples]
  # groups = factor(ed2[sel_samples,]$group)
  # site = factor(ed2[sel_samples,]$site_ac)
  # 
  # design = model.matrix(~ site + groups ,  contrasts.arg=list(groups=contr.SAS))
  # 
  # fit <- lmFit(edata,design)
  # fit <- eBayes(fit)
  # all_results_betas[["nonIMvsNormal"]] = topTable(fit, coef="groups1", adjust="BH", number=nrow(edata))
  # 
  # IM vs. Normal, adjusted per sample for stomach site
  sel_conditions = "IM"
  target_avg_samples = rownames(subset(ed2, group %in% sel_conditions) )
  normal_avg_samples = rownames(subset(ed2, group =="Normal") )
  normal_sites <- ed2[normal_avg_samples, "site_ac"]
  adj_betas = list()
  for( s in target_avg_samples) {
    site <- ed2[s, "site_ac"]
    adj_betas[[s]] <- avg_combined[, s] - rowMeans(avg_combined[, normal_avg_samples][, normal_sites==site])
  }
  target_to_normal_diff <- do.call(cbind, adj_betas)
  
  fit <- lmFit(target_to_normal_diff)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)
  all_results_betas[["IMvsNormal_site.adj"]] = topTable(fit, coef="x1", adjust="BH", number=nrow(edata))
  

  # non-IM vs. Normal, adjusted per sample for stomach site
  sel_conditions = "NON.IM"
  target_avg_samples = rownames(subset(ed2, group %in% sel_conditions) )
  normal_avg_samples = rownames(subset(ed2, group =="Normal") )
  normal_sites <- ed2[normal_avg_samples, "site_ac"]
  adj_betas = list()
  for( s in target_avg_samples) {
    site <- ed2[s, "site_ac"]
    adj_betas[[s]] <- avg_combined[, s] - rowMeans(avg_combined[, normal_avg_samples][, normal_sites==site])
  }
  target_to_normal_diff <- do.call(cbind, adj_betas)
  
  fit <- lmFit(target_to_normal_diff)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)
  all_results_betas[["nonIMvsNormal_site.adj"]] = topTable(fit, coef="x1", adjust="BH", number=nrow(edata))
    
  
  
  all_results_betas_annotated = list()
  for (n in names(all_results_betas)) {
    tmp = all_results_betas[[n]]
    tmp = merge(tmp, avg_combined, by=0, all.x=T, sort=F)
    tmp = merge(tmp, as.data.frame(full_anno), by.x="Row.names", by.y=0, sort=F, all.x=T )
    tmp <- merge(tmp, wgs_dm_anno, by.x="Row.names", by.y=0, all.x=T, sort=F)
    tmp <- merge(tmp, u.m_anno, by.x="Row.names", by.y="ID", all.x=T, sort=F)
    all_results_betas_annotated[[n]] = tmp
  }
        
  save(all_results_betas_annotated, file=file.path(data_storage_folder, "all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_with_healthy_annotated.RData"))
} else {
  load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_with_healthy_annotated.RData"))
}
```

## Volcano Plots

### Subgroups

For each comparison, the distribution of the differential methylation values (delta beta) and the negative logarithm of the adjusted p-values are plotted in the following volcano plots. The red line marks the cutoff of 0.05 of the FDR.

#### FDR < 5%

```{r Volcano Plots adj. p-val, fig.width=12,fig.height = 7.5}
all_target_conditions = names(all_results_betas_annotated)
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
for (tc in all_target_conditions) {
  r = all_results_betas_annotated[[tc]]
  plot(r$logFC, -log10(r$adj.P.Val),xlab="delta beta",ylab="-log10(adj. p-val)", ylim=c(0,max(2,max(-log10(r$adj.P.Val),na.rm=T))), xlim=(c(-1, 1)))
  title(main=tc, sub=paste("(",nrow(subset(r, adj.P.Val < 0.05 & (logFC > 0.2 | logFC < -0.2)))," diff. meth. Cgs after adjusting (FDR < 5 %, db > 20 %))",sep="") )
  abline(h=-log10(0.05),col="red")
    abline(v=-0.2, lty = 2)
  abline(v=0.2, lty = 2)
}

```
